# Necronomics - Website-Based Game

## Project Setup Complete ✓

A Next.js project with React and Tailwind CSS has been initialized for building a website-based game.

## Tech Stack

- **Next.js**: React framework with App Router
- **React**: UI library
- **Tailwind CSS**: Utility-first CSS framework
- **TypeScript**: Type safety
- **ESLint**: Code linting

## Project Structure

```
app/
├── page.tsx           # Home page
├── layout.tsx         # Root layout
└── globals.css        # Global styles with Tailwind

public/               # Static assets
components/           # React components (create this)
lib/                  # Utilities and helpers (create this)
```

## Available Scripts

- `npm run dev` - Start development server at http://localhost:3000
- `npm run build` - Build for production
- `npm run start` - Start production server
- `npm run lint` - Run ESLint

## Getting Started

1. Run the dev server: `npm run dev`
2. Open http://localhost:3000 in your browser
3. Start building game components in the `app` directory

## Game Development Tips

- Create reusable components in a `components/` directory
- Use Tailwind CSS classes for styling
- Organize game logic in `lib/` utilities
- Leverage Next.js API routes for backend if needed
